          THE RULE IS THE PRODUCT
          
Spend three charges.
Get them back one at a time.

        

        

          

            Recharging is sequential: spend all three Comet steps and the first
            returns after 3.5 seconds, the next after 7, the last after 10.5.
            Using another stored charge keeps the current recharge moving.
          

          

            Pause the host clock and everything waits. Resume, scale time, or
            restore a snapshot and the same explicit policy still applies.

if (cast.ok) world.cast('blink');
